name: AWS — Secret or Parameter Retrieval Targeting Credentials
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("GetSecretValue","GetParameter","GetParameters","GetParametersByPath","DescribeSecret","ListSecrets")
| filter xdm.event.description contains "rootCredentials"
       or xdm.event.description contains "MasterKey"
       or xdm.event.description contains "SuperUser"
       or xdm.event.description contains "BreakGlass"
       or xdm.event.description contains "service_account_key"
       or xdm.event.description contains "encryption_key"
| filter not (xdm.event.description contains "AssumedRole"
       or xdm.event.description contains "AWSServiceRoleFor"
       or xdm.event.description contains "/aws-service-role/"
       or xdm.event.description contains "InstanceProfile")
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as access_count,
       count_distinct(xdm.event.description) as distinct_secrets,
       values(xdm.event.description) as accessed_secrets,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations
       by xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.user.username, _time
| filter access_count >= 5 or distinct_secrets >= 3
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.user.username, operations, accessed_secrets
description: GetSecretValue, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, DescribeSecret, or ListSecrets event where requestParameters contain 'credential', 'password', 'token', 'api_key', '/secret', '/key', or 'private'.
alert_name: AWS — Secret or Parameter Retrieval Targeting Credentials
alert_description:
What fired: GetSecretValue, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, DescribeSecret, or ListSecrets event where requestParameters contain 'credential', 'password', 'token', 'api_key', '/secret', '/key', or 'private'.

Why it matters: an actor is attempting to obtain or brute-force credentials. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1552.001 - Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files (TA0006 - Credential Access).

Investigate:
  - Identify the targeted account(s) and the source IP, and check for a SUCCESSFUL authentication following the failures.
  - Determine whether the source is expected; look for MFA prompts, password resets, or new sessions from the same source.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0006 - Credential Access: T1552.001 - Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files
